origin.description: Creates a document_position, which can be used to indicate e.g. the row + column location of the cursor in a document.
origin.details: Existing document_position objects are returned unchanged. A numeric vector of length two becomes document_position(x[[1]], x[[2]]).

translation.description: Creates a document_position, which can be used to indicate e.g. the row + column location of the cursor in a document.
translation.details: Existing document_position objects are returned unchanged. A numeric vector of length two becomes document_position(x[0], x[1]).
translation.example:
import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from rstudioapi.as_document_position import as_document_position, document_position, print_document_position
pos = document_position(1, 5)
print_document_position(as_document_position(pos))
print_document_position(as_document_position((3.0, 7.0)))
